name: Locomotion Store Lobby Ready Lock
notes: Quest/Oculus locomotion re-locked: right stick up/down moves forward/back and right stick left/right snap-turns 45 degrees.
Controller teleport reworked to hold A/grip/trigger to aim and release to teleport, avoiding accidental instant teleport and stuck toggle states.
Lobby music remains manual only through M key or the watch music button.
Reiki hologram remains paused by default and activates only from the Reiki area route.
Store portal added as a VR lobby web portal pointing to https://svrpoker.com/site/store.html.
Unapproved Reiki sponsor/founder runtime assets and references removed; SVR awaiting-approval placeholders preserved.
